thread:
sarah: Quick postmortem follow-up after today's vendor/dependency outage (cloud zone flapping + model-registry auth expiries). We need concrete owners, short timelines, and a recurring pattern review. Assigning now.

mike: I will own vendor engagement and escalation. Plan: contact cloud-support, request root cause writeup, and draft an SLA/credit ask. Target: initial vendor outreach by EOD tomorrow, draft ask by Friday. @julia can you help with legal wording?

kevin: I'll own model-registry auth hardening and runtime fallback. Proposed steps: 1) automate token refresh for registry service accounts, 2) implement transient auth retry with jitter, 3) add cached-artifact fallback in router. ETA: 2 weeks for full automation, but I can push a hotfix fallback in 48h.

julia: Will prepare a contract amendment template and SLA clause suggestions. Need impact numbers (RPS, minutes downtime, revenue hit) to quantify credits. Target review copy to legal by Wed.

infra-bot: Created tickets INC-7011 (vendor-sla-engagement) and INC-7012 (registry-auth-fallback).

ops-oncall: Short-term runbook update added: manual service key rotation steps and immediate fallback switching. Runbook link: https://go/redwood/runbooks/vendor-fallback (internal).

sarah: Action items for tracker (please update INC tickets with status and ETAs):
1) Vendor SLA ask (owner: mike) 3 target EOD Fri for initial ask,
2) Contract draft (owner: julia) 3 review Wed,
3) Registry auth automation (owner: kevin) 3 2w,
4) Short-term fallback (owner: kevin/ops) 3 48h hotfix,
5) Monitoring & recurring RCA cadence (owner: sarah) 3 schedule by Mon.

mike: I'll also propose a routing policy for the smart router: prefer regional replica -> cached artifact -> degraded small model. Adding to INC-7011.

kevin: Hotfix config I'll push to Dedicated runtime:

```yaml
fallback_policy:
  enabled: true
  order:
    - region_replica
    - cached_model
    - small_degraded_model
  retries: 2
  backoff: exponential
```

kevin: The hotfix plus a short-lived cached model should let the fleet ride through provider auth blips while automation lands.

julia: Legal note: when we ask for credits, quantify impact (tokens/min * minutes down) + high-level revenue estimate. Can product/SRE help with quick numbers?

sarah: @product and @sre please provide a short impact calc by EOD so legal has figures.

mike: Noting a recurring pattern: minor vendor auth flaps over last 3 months and two registry token-rotation incidents. Suggest monthly vendor-dependency review and a synthetic test that simulates token expiry.

kevin: I'll add a synthetic CI job that rotates a test service token weekly and validates registry access; failures will page oncall.

ops-oncall: Recommend automating router switch when vendor-zone health degrades to prefer cached_model. I added a checkbox in INC-7012 for this automation.

sarah: I'll create the action tracker spreadsheet and link it in INC tickets. Interim owners: mike/julia/kevin. Weekly status updates in #incidents every Monday.

mike: Question: do we want legal to negotiate right to run cross-regional fallback tests against vendor infra? Could be useful to prove resilience.

julia: We can request that as an optional clause in the SLA/annex. I'll include it as a request and flag for sales/contract review.

sarah: Final asks: update your INC tickets with ETAs, break down sub-tasks, and mark blockers. I'll follow up in tomorrow's infra sync. :calendar:

kevin: Updated INC-7012 with sub-tasks: hotfix, automation, synthetic test.

mike: INC-7011 updated with vendor contact and initial ask draft attached.

infra-bot: INC-7011 status changed to "In progress" by mike.

sarah: Thanks all. We'll reconvene in the weekly incident review. If blockers appear, ping me directly. :eyes:

ops-oncall: Note for oncall: on registry 5xx spikes run fallback playbook, then escalate to infra.

sarah: Pinned thread summary: owners (mike/julia/kevin), timelines (48h hotfix, 2w automation, Fri/Wed legal), synthetic testing + monthly dependency review. Update INC tickets by EOD.
